checkpoint_policy: Atomic state after every result; preserve unfinished batch on resume; terminal errors/incomplete histories are retained and not retried automatically.
cutoff: Unchanged extractor: only confirmed transactions at heights strictly below each reference-payment block; exclude that entire block and later activity.
evaluation: Source feature dataset construction only. One incident, unknown compromise/hardware labels, no legitimate controls or fitting.
publication: Prefix-only evidence, feature vectors, collection/selection hashes and aggregate comparison; raw address histories remain local under ignored raw/.

recovery.changed_bounds: 16 pages rather than 4; 15-second request timeout rather than 8; workers remain 2. An empty terminal page and matching stable provider counters remain mandatory.
recovery.original_preservation: Copy the 473 complete normalized entries unchanged into a separate recovery state; keep all original checkpoint bytes and failures.
recovery.purpose: Recover address histories only; not victim/device attribution or model fitting.
recovery.selection: Exactly the 24 errors and 3 incomplete sources in the exhausted pinned checkpoint; one new attempt each, no replacement or automatic retry.

sampling: Fixed SHA256 order of all 500 candidate sources; cached sources stay in the cohort; choose the first 20 pending records as a batch before requests, without replacing failures.
